It's said that once you have a taste of this cake, you'll never forget its sweetness.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Monster Cakes are a variety of [[Cake]] made by [[Cooking]] [[Tabantha Wheat]], [[Cane Sugar]], [[Goat Butter]], and [[Monster Extract]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Being made with Monster Extract, the amount of [[Heart]]s they restore to [[Link]] will be random when they are made. The Monster Extract will also randomize the strength and duration of any status effects the Cake has. It is said that once one has a taste, they will never forget the sweetness of Monster Cake. The second ''[[Castle Library Book]]'' details the recipe for Monster Cake, describing it as a secret recipe of the [[Royal Family of Hyrule]] and the favorite of an unnamed chancellor.{{Cite|The Royal Family's Secret Recipe #2
The Chancellor's Favorite: {{Color BotW|Red|Monster Cake}}|Castle Library Book|BotW}} The book instructs its reader to stew Monster Extract, Tabantha Wheat, Cane Sugar, and Goat Butter together for a short while.{{Cite|Stew monster extract, Tabantha wheat, cane sugar, and goat butter for a spell.|Castle Library Book|BotW}} However, it warns that these Cakes make one's head fuzzy and may motivate someone to plan evil schemes.{{Cite|It's a dangerous dish that makes your head fuzzy and may even motivate you to plan evil schemes!|Castle Library Book|BotW}} Monster Cake is one of two [[Meal]]s Link can give to [[Gotter]] as part of the "[[A Royal Recipe]]" [[Side Quest]].{{Cite|[Give him monster cake.] This monster cake is said to have been a favorite of the minister of Hyrule.|Gotter|BotW}} At first, he likens the Cake to biting into a [[Chuchu]].{{Cite|It tastes...beautiful... How can I put it into words? It's like biting into a Chuchu...|Gotter|BotW}} However, realizing that would be disgusting and dangerous, he instead claims it stimulates the brain like being pummeled by a [[Hinox]].{{Cite|No, no, that would be disgusting and dangerous. It stimulates the brain, much like being pummeled by a Hinox!|Gotter|BotW}} He calls it an elegant dish, saying he never thought he would taste something so thrilling.{{Cite|A truly elegant dish! I never thought I would taste something quite so thrilling.|Gotter|BotW}} As thanks, Gotter will give Link a [[Silver Rupee]].{{Cite|I really must thank you for such a beautiful meal! Here, take this. For your trouble.|Gotter|BotW}} Once the "[[From the Ground Up]]" Side Quest has been completed, Link can eavesdrop on [[Ruli]] and [[Hagie]] during the night in [[Tarrey Town]]. Ruli laments that their daughter, [[Hunnie]], is sick and will only eat Cake, and she wonders whether anything can be done.{{Cite|Our daughter... The only thing she'll eat is {{Color BotW|Red|cake}}. Can't anything be done?|Ruli|BotW}} No matter how much searching they have done, Hagie notes they have not been able to find a Cake that can please her.{{Cite|We've scoured the world, searching for a cake that would please her. None have. Imagine how much money we've spent...|Hagie|BotW}} Ruli states that she would sell her soul to [[Monster]] for a Cake to cure Hunnie.{{Cite|Even if I have to sell my soul to a {{Color BotW|Red|monster}}, I'll get my hands on a {{Color BotW|Red|cake}} that can cure our daughter!|Ruli|BotW}} This initiates the "[[A Parent's Love]]" Side Quest. During this Side Quest, Link can give Ruli a Monster Cake for Hunnie.{{Cite|What is... Is this a {{Color BotW|Blue|monster cake}}? I should give this to my daughter?|Ruli|BotW}} She thanks Link for the gift, noting its pungent smell.{{Cite|Thank you so much! Oh, wow. It's certainly quite pungent... Phew.|Ruli|BotW}} However, she decides not to complain, since this could be the Cake that heals Hunnie.{{Cite|I suppose I can't complain about things like that. If our daughter can get better thanks to this cake...|Ruli|BotW}} Ruli decides to have her daughter eat it right away.{{Cite|I'll wake her up right away and try to get her to eat it.|Ruli|BotW}}{{Cite|I'll try to get her to eat it right away.|Ruli|BotW}} After this is done, Hunnie will begin to run around and play. Ruli thanks Link, noting that Hunnie's health has returned.{{Cite|Thank you so much! That {{Color BotW|Blue|monster cake}}... Our daughter wolfed it down with unbelievable gusto. It seems her health has returned to her!|Ruli|BotW}} As a reward, she will give Link a [[Gold Rupee]].{{Cite|I don't know what to say—I'm just so thankful! Oh, I know. This isn't much, but please take it.|Ruli|BotW}} By adding a fifth [[Ingredient]], several different variations of Monster Cake can be made: * '''Chilly Monster Cake''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Monster Cake}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
It's said that once you have a taste of this cake, you'll never forget its sweetness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a chilly Ingredient. Eating them will grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. * '''Electro Monster Cake''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Monster Cake}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
It's said that once you have a taste of this cake, you'll never forget its sweetness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding an electric Ingredient. Eating them will grant Link one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Enduring Monster Cake''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Monster Cake}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
It's said that once you have a taste of this cake, you'll never forget its sweetness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding an enduring Ingredient. Link's [[Stamina Wheel]] will be completely restored and overfilled if he eats these. * '''Energizing Monster Cake''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Monster Cake}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
It's said that once you have a taste of this cake, you'll never forget its sweetness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding an energizing Ingredients. Eating these Cakes will restore a portion of Link's Stamina Wheel. * '''Hasty Monster Cake''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Monster Cake}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
It's said that once you have a taste of this cake, you'll never forget its sweetness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a hasty Ingredient. If Link eats these, his movement speed will be increased. * '''Hearty Monster Cake''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Monster Cake}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
It's said that once you have a taste of this cake, you'll never forget its sweetness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a hearty Ingredient. When eaten, all of Link's Hearts will be healed, and his maximum number of Hearts will be temporarily increased. * '''Mighty Monster Cake''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Monster Cake}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
It's said that once you have a taste of this cake, you'll never forget its sweetness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a mighty Ingredients. When eaten, Link will receive a boost to the power of his attacks. * '''Sneaky Monster Cake''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Monster Cake}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
It's said that once you have a taste of this cake, you'll never forget its sweetness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a sneaky Ingredients. They increase Link's [[Stealth]] when he eats them. * '''Spicy Monster Cake''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Monster Cake}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
It's said that once you have a taste of this cake, you'll never forget its sweetness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a spicy Ingredient. These Cakes will grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]] when eaten. * '''Tough Monster Cake''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Monster Cake}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
It's said that once you have a taste of this cake, you'll never forget its sweetness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a tough Ingredient. If consumed, Link's defense will be increased. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The Recipe for Monster Cake is obtained by completing the [[Scenario]] "[[The Future of Hyrule]]". It is made using two [[Tabantha Wheat]]s, two [[Cane Sugar]]s, two [[Goat Butter]]s, and two [[Monster Extract]]s. Through the completion of the [[Quest]] "[[Hungry Hunches]]", however, the number of each required ingredient can be reduced to one. [[Cooking]] a Monster Cake before a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]] increases all of the [[Warrior]]s' stats by five percent but reduces their maximum [[Health]] by ten percent. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Trivia== * The twin-horned design of the Monster Cake, its description as the favorite of the royal chancellor, and its reputation to motivate someone to plan evil schemes may be a reference to [[Cole]] from {{ST}}. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Monster Cake Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for Monster Cake ==See Also== {{See Also| * Cake * Food * Meal }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Cakes, Desserts, Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
